title: Damaged and Defective Items Replacement Policy
content: Customers are eligible for a full replacement or refund if an item arrives damaged or defective. The request must be submitted within 7 calendar days of delivery with proof of damage (photo/video).

title: Standard Change of Mind Return Policy
content: For items where the customer changed their mind, returns are allowed within 3 calendar days of delivery. Item must be unopened, in original packaging, and with all tags intact.

title: Order Tracking and Transit Times
content: Orders placed before 2 PM are shipped the same business day. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Real-time tracking is updated via the courier API.

title: Refund Processing Timeline
content: Once an item is received and inspected at our distribution warehouse, refunds are automatically issued within 5 to 7 business days to the customer's original payment method.
